name: computer-use
description: Control desktop apps on Linux from Codex through Computer Use.

interface.shortDescription: Control Linux desktop apps from Codex
interface.longDescription: Linux Computer Use lets Codex inspect and control desktop apps through a native Linux backend using screenshots, accessibility metadata, and input events. Enable or disable native access in Settings → Computer use → Any App. Browser access is configured independently.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Linux Computer Use is ready
